unresolved.reason: S.I. No. 26 of 2026 is the current controlling visa-exemption instrument listed by the official laws portal, but its text and consolidated schedule were unavailable during the announced 21–24 August 2026 maintenance. The official publication notice does not state whether it retains, narrows, or replaces the earlier China tourism/business exception; no current CN status is promoted.

S.I. No. 26 of 2026 and the current consolidated visa-exemption schedule could not be retrieved from the official legislation or Gazette services during their announced maintenance. No accessible current official text establishes whether any older Taiwan rule remains, is amended, or is repealed; no current TW status is promoted.

The official 2024 amendment added nationals of Guyana to the prior Order, but the subsequently published S.I. No. 26 of 2026 is inaccessible during the official maintenance period. Its repeal, saving, transition, and schedule clauses must be read before treating the 2024 amendment as current; no GY status is promoted.
